draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Yes, you're welcome to bring the cement mixer trailer back to the Oulu depot. We can take it during our normal opening hours, no appointment needed — just let me know roughly which day works for you, and make sure it comes back with everything it went out with.

I'm still checking fleet availability for the 13-tonne excavator and will come back to you separately on delivery options.

Best regards,
Petri Isokangas
Senior Coordinator, Haapaharju Oy
